text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the 2023 tree removal was authorized.** That would require checking relevant permits or other official records.

The data show 0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2023. Of that area, 0.4 hectares was mapped as planted eucalyptus forest in 2021, and 0.3 hectares was outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest. These classifications do not determine whether authorization was required or granted.
